text_block_list.text:
It was a fateful encounter.
The weather had been gloomy
since morning,
leaving me in a bit of a funk.

Once the rain let up,
I took a stroll around campus
to stretch my legs after being stuck at my
desk all day……
Haa, haa, haa……!

Most Uma Musume were likely doing indoor
workouts today.
It seemed she was the very first one out on
the track
the moment the rain cleared……
Oho……looking good.
――Haaaaaaa!

She had been running lightly as if checking
her footing, when suddenly she surged,
accelerating violently into the corner
and showcasing the sheer power in her
stride.

――Phew……looks like my warm-up is done!
I can keep going like this all day♪

Oh, were you watching?
Well……judging by that look on
your face,
I don't even need to ask what you thought!

Fufufu,
but this is nothing compared to how I run
in a race.
When the real thing starts,
I shine even brighter!

Her eyes held an unwavering fire as she spoke.
She had absolute
confidence in herself……and it left a truly
dazzling impression.
Well then, see ya around――Bye now!

My intuition screamed,
『It has to be her!』 If I were to scout
anyone, it had to be her.
All my gloom instantly vanished.
My heart was racing. It felt just like……

A few days later,
after chasing down what few clues I had,
I discovered she was running in today's mock
race.
Taking a chance, I rushed over to watch……!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Good afternoon,
trainers! I'm Satono Crown.
Make sure you keep your eyes glued to my
run today!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
So she's the one,
the elite Uma Musume from the Satono
family.
No doubt about it,
she's the star of today's show.

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Her mock race results have been flawless so
far—undefeated!
A bright personality,
brimming with confidence…… She's top-tier
in every way.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, everyone's looking at you!
As expected of Kura-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Dia! You came!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Of course! As a fellow Satono,
there's no way
I'd miss your race, Kura-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Our dream……the Satono family's long-cherished
wish.
You're the closest one to achieving it,
after all, Kura-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Dia……thank you.
I'll debut soon and prove I can win a G1
crown.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Watch closely today, alright?
Once your career begins,
you'll be walking this exact path too!

『The Satono Family's long-cherished wish』……a
famous topic in
racing circles. Though relatively new,
the Satono family
had already made immense contributions to
the turf.

However,
there was one milestone they had yet to
reach:
『Producing a G1-winning Uma Musume』.

Thus,
the crowning ambition of the Satono family
was to bring forth an Uma Musume capable of
claiming G1 glory.

――While those thoughts crossed my mind,
the gates opened.

Positioned in mid-pack,
Satono Crown surveyed the field with total
poise. Then, flashing a fearless smile,
she unleashed her burst at the perfect
instant.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Haaaaa————!

Down the final stretch,
she pulled away in an instant, seizing
first place with effortless ease.
A truly magnificent victory……!

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text:
That was spectacular!
Won't you join our team?
I can bring your potential to the next
level!
choice_data_list: No, me! Together, for your dream……!
No, me! Together, for your dream……!

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I have past experience guiding a Derby Uma
Musume to greatness.
With my track record,
I can coach you to perfection……!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
If you're aiming overseas,
I have plenty of international
connections……!
We also boast state-of-the-art training
facilities……!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright, everyone,
thank you so much!
But could you please calm down for just a
moment?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to my training regimen and
race planning,
I intend to scrutinize every single detail
carefully.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
After all,
my family's greatest dream rests upon
this.

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
……The Satono Group's wish,
huh…… That's true. If we took charge
and failed to deliver on that
expectation……

The trainers fell silent,
visibly daunted by Satono Crown's words.
No ordinary,
half-hearted determination could ever hope
to shoulder that burden.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Therefore,
I'd like all of you to think deeply about
whether
you're truly prepared to walk this demanding
road with me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'll be waiting for someone with that level
of resolve!
Now then, if you'll excuse me――

I hadn't managed to speak up or pitch myself
among the crowd.
Yet despite that,
the fire in my heart remained unwavering.

At the very least,
I had to convey my resolve and passion.
That determination was the one thing I
wouldn't lose on……!
With that conviction, I ran after her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Are you serious……? Truly? You really……
choice_data_list: Really. I want to form a contract――
Really. I want to form a contract――

text_block_list.text:
――I passionately laid out my vision to help
her claim that dream.
Even I was surprised by how the words kept
pouring out uncontrollably……

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Phew…… I understand your logic.
Though what stands out to me even more
is……

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You're brimming with sheer motivation,
aren't you? I don't dislike that at all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
In fact……to shatter the 『Satono Jinx』,
what we need might just
be something wonderfully irrational—
like that burning passion of yours……

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Alright,
deal!
How about we start with a provisional
contract?
Show me what you're truly capable of.
choice_data_list: ……! Thank you, looking forward to it!
……! Thank you, looking forward to it!

text_block_list.text:
And so began my trial period to earn her
full trust!
However,
during our very first strategy meeting,
she dropped a surprising revelation……

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
……So,
I'll be quite busy assisting with my father's
business soon. For now,
we'll need to coordinate and adjust my
available training hours.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I assist with my family's corporate operations
from time to time.
Once I debut, my schedule will be tighter,
so I want to learn as much as I can right
now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I've already drafted a training menu designed
around my spare time……
Here, please look it over as well.

Come to think of it…… I still don't know
much about her.
I felt unless I understand her deeper,
proper support is impossible.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, interested? Splendid!
That would be a immense help,
so please do!
